desc: Derive the greedy reduction with formula total = sum_v a_v*(2v - a_v - 1)/2 where a_v = number of smaller values to the right of v; hand-verified on samples ([3,2,1]->4, [2,4,1,3,5]->6, [1,2]->0), on [4,3,2,1]->10, [2,4,3,1]->8, [3,4,2,1]->9, [2,1,4,3]->4, and the reverse-permutation closed form C(N+1,3).
Implement the O(N log N) Fenwick solution and confirm it passes all three provided samples (sample tests PASSED).
Independently brute-force verify the formula against Dijkstra over all permutations for N=2..7 and run the large N=2*10^5 worst-case timing/answer check; no mismatch reported.
